t: This is the tomb of Marigold Churchill, in Kensal Green Cemetery. Marigold was the fourth child of Winston and Clementine Churchill, and she died at the age of two, in 1921. The tomb was designed by Eric Gill, the sculptor, letter cutter and typeface designer, and it is Grade II listed. Marigold's body no longer lies here. In 2020 she was reinterred in the Churchill family plot at St Martin's Church in Bladon, Oxfordshire, so this monument marks where she was first laid to rest.
